quote: Theorem1: Let X ~ MOKwG(α1, a, b) and Y ~ MOKwG(α2, a, b). If α1 < α2, then X ≤lr Y (X ≤hr Y, X ≤rhr Y, X ≤st Y).
family: Marshall–Olkin-Kumaraswamy-G distribution MOKwG(α,a,b): sf F̄(t) = [1 − (1 − G(t)^a)^b] / [1 − ᾱ(1 − G(t)^a)^b]-style Marshall-Olkin transform of Kw-G; baseline G arbitrary continuous cdf
compared: two MOKwG members differing only in the Marshall–Olkin parameter α

hypotheses.text: X ~ MOKwG(α1, a, b) and Y ~ MOKwG(α2, a, b)
hypotheses.formal: same a, b and baseline G; only α differs

conclusion.direction: X ≤_lr Y (and consequently X ≤hr Y, X ≤rhr Y, X ≤st Y)

ambiguity: The subsidiary orders follow from the implication chain X ≤rhr Y ⇐ X ≤lr Y ⇒ X ≤hr Y ⇒ X ≤st Y given in the paper's eq. (24).
